content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Lightning Record Pages ## slug: vt-lightning-record-pages ## seoTitle: Lightning Record Pages ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The most common location for the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}} is on a Lightning Record Page. Follow the steps below to add the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}} to a Lightning Record Page. 1. Navigate to the Lightning Record Page where you want to place the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}}. 2. Click the **Gear icon** in the upper right-hand corner. 3. Click **Edit Page** to open the Lightning App Builder. 4. Scroll down to the Custom - Managed section in the Components sidebar. ![Lightning Record Pages_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Lightning%20Record%20Pages_1.png){height="" width=""} 6. Locate the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}} component in the list. 7. Drag and drop it onto the section, tab, or location of your choosing on the Lightning Record Page. ![Lightning Record Pages_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Lightning%20Record%20Pages_2.png){height="" width=""} 9. To ensure the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}} uses the correct record as the Parent Object, set the {{variable.Field_VT_RecordID}} input to "{record.id}". ![Lightning Record Pages_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Lightning%20Record%20Pages_3.png){height="" width=""} 11. You can also add filters for component visibility if you want the {{variable.Component_BTPayVirtualTerminal}} to only appear on a page when the specified criteria are met. 12. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} when you are done making the desired changes. You can now make additional configurations such as adding fields, pre-populating values, customizing labels, or further customizing the visible actions and defaults on the user interface.
